name: 個人情報の手続を福祉機構に引き継ぐ
summary: 県の個人情報保護に関する条例に、福祉機構の設立前後の手続を引き継ぐ規定を加えます。設立前に知事が行った処分や手続、知事に出された請求などを、設立後は福祉機構が行った、または受けたものとして扱います。
changes: 知事が行った処分や手続を福祉機構が行ったものとして扱う
知事に出された請求などを福祉機構に出されたものとして扱う
who: 福祉機構が引き継ぐ事務について、県に請求などをした人
why: 地方独立行政法人神奈川県立福祉機構の設立に伴い、所要の改正をするためと、県は説明しています。

en.name: Transfers personal information procedures to the welfare organization
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act on the Protection of Personal Information
en.summary: Adds provisions to the prefecture's ordinance on the protection of personal information to transfer procedures from before and after the Welfare Organization is established. After its establishment, dispositions and procedures carried out by the governor before its establishment, as well as requests and other matters submitted to the governor, will be treated as having been carried out or received by the Welfare Organization.
changes: Treat dispositions and procedures carried out by the governor as having been carried out by the Welfare Organization
Treat requests and other matters submitted to the governor as having been submitted to the Welfare Organization
who: People who made requests or other submissions to the prefecture about matters to be taken over by the Welfare Organization
en.why: The prefecture says this is to make the necessary amendments in connection with the establishment of the Kanagawa Prefectural Welfare Organization, a local incorporated administrative agency.
